[EN] It's the {@LinkCreature:4#1011#fangspawns}. All bite, no bark. Reach out to them, and you'll pull back a bloody stump.

Wipe out the fangspawns, and bring back their hearts. Then we'll be getting somewhere.

The smell repels other meat-eaters.
[ES] Son los {@LinkCreature:4#1011#fangspawns}. Puro mordisco, cero ladridos. Acércate a ellos y retirarás un muñón ensangrentado.

Aniquila a los fangspawns y tráeme sus corazones. Entonces estaremos avanzando.

El olor repele a otros carnívoros.

[EN] Those fangspawns breed fast, but you kill 'em even faster, eh?
[ES] Esos fangspawns se reproducen rápido, pero tú los matas aún más rápido, ¿eh?

[EN] Look, we can't reopen the mines until the fangspawns are taken care of.

It's hard to swing a pick when some fangspawn has chewed your arms off!
[ES] Mira, no podemos reabrir las minas hasta que nos encarguemos de los fangspawns.

¡Es difícil balancear un pico cuando un fangspawn te ha arrancado los brazos!
